history.overview: The Bloodfields are the primary warfront between Muramite forces and Kuua’s resistance factions.

timeline.name: Warfront Formation
timeline.description: Muramite legions established forward positions across the Bloodfields.

timeline.name: Resistance Sabotage
timeline.description: Resistance forces began sabotaging supply lines and command posts.

timeline.name: Discord Ruptures
timeline.description: Discord energy ruptured the terrain, creating unstable rifts.

timeline.name: Citadel Advance
timeline.description: Muramite forces pushed toward Dranik’s Scar, intensifying conflict.

timeline.name: Current Era
timeline.description: The Bloodfields remain the most active warzone in Kuua.
